course_objective: Prevent delivery defects from altering the practice
source_locator: QCTP source-fidelity standard; Day 1 natural-session audit
source_operation: Preview the selected continuous bed, learned soft pre-cue marker, and guide level before the timed session
source_faithful_baseline: No teacher method begins during readiness
qctp_enhancement: Local/offline pack check; headphone and volume confirmation; marker preview; one dominant Begin control

course_objective: Observe the state present before deliberate change
source_operation: Observe current mental tone, emotion, breath, jaw, shoulders, chest, gut, and general activation without changing them yet
source_faithful_baseline: A brief source-neutral baseline observation precedes all source methods
qctp_enhancement: One-action-at-a-time wording; quiet support bed; no interpretation or state claim

course_objective: Recognize physical contraction and permit release
source_operation: Bring attention to recognizable contraction in the gut, heart, muscles, or nervous system; feel what is present; release rather than suppress; use acceptance or gratitude; intentionally allow a higher quality into the opened space
source_faithful_baseline: Notice the clearest contraction; stay with the physical sensation without digging for a story; allow a small release; transition toward acceptance or gratitude
qctp_enhancement: Posture support; do-not-force guard; no trauma excavation; predictable cues; transition explicitly names the end of the Bullard-derived segment

course_objective: Learn the exact source breath entry
source_operation: Focus attention in the heart area; imagine breath flowing in and out through the heart or chest; breathe a little slower and deeper; suggested five seconds in and five seconds out or another comfortable rhythm
source_faithful_baseline: Coach five seconds in and five seconds out for several easy cycles with no hold; comfort overrides exact timing
qctp_enhancement: Quiet audible breath rail after initial counted cycles; no nasal-only claim; reduce depth before changing rhythm if effort rises

course_objective: Generate and stabilize a regenerative state
source_operation: Make a sincere attempt to experience appreciation or care; calm or ease may be used; re-experience the feeling connected with a person, pet, place, accomplishment, or similar source
source_faithful_baseline: Use one real memory or reference to evoke appreciation, care, calm, or ease; attend to the felt shift rather than repeating words
qctp_enhancement: Teach tier explains that a faint genuine shift counts; memory can be released after the feeling appears; voice density tapers; no forced positivity

course_objective: Recognize focused attention before widening it
source_locator: Dr Joe Dispenza official induction descriptions; awareness of a body area and its place in space
source_operation: Place attention on a defined body area and sense the space it occupies rather than analyzing it
source_faithful_baseline: Sense the volume occupied by the head and the space between the ears while remaining aware that this area exists in space
qctp_enhancement: Clarify sensing versus visual construction; prompt one neutral return when attention becomes a story; no brainwave or advanced-state claim

course_objective: Move deliberately from convergent to divergent attention
source_locator: Dr Joe Dispenza official Part I and induction support pages
source_operation: Move from narrow or object focus to opening and broadening attention toward the space around the selected body area
source_faithful_baseline: Shift from the head as an object to sensing the space surrounding the head; compare effort and mental activity
qctp_enhancement: Slow cue pacing; learned marker; enough silence to feel the contrast; no generic breath count inserted

course_objective: Expand awareness around the whole body
source_locator: Dr Joe Dispenza official Part I: sensing or feeling the space around us
source_operation: Sense or feel the space surrounding the body and allow attention to become less object-bound
source_faithful_baseline: Include the space around the chest, abdomen, back, limbs, and whole body as one continuous surrounding volume
qctp_enhancement: Progressive scale cues; distinguish receptive sensing from imagined scenery; attention-capture recovery prompt; support bed continues

source_locator: Dr Joe Dispenza official Part I: broadening focus to space or nothingness
source_operation: Continue broad spatial attention beyond the body rather than returning to individual objects
source_faithful_baseline: Sense the space between the body and the room boundaries, then the room as one volume; let sounds occur within the same field without chasing them
qctp_enhancement: Major cue density reduction; no promise of alpha, theta, boundary loss, or quantum-field entry; drowsiness correction remains available

course_objective: Measure whether the trained state persists after the source method ends
source_operation: End the Dispenza-derived spatial operation explicitly before beginning source-neutral observation
source_faithful_baseline: Stop deliberately widening attention; let awareness organize itself and notice what remains of physical ease, appreciation, and spaciousness
qctp_enhancement: Explicit teacher-boundary announcement; support bed remains stable; no simultaneous blending attributed to either source

source_locator: QCTP workbook baseline-awareness and raw-observation requirements
source_operation: Release all techniques and observe current consciousness, body, emotion, breath, and spatial awareness
source_faithful_baseline: No breath control, imagery, emotional generation, counting, or spatial expansion; notice only what is present
qctp_enhancement: Low narration; one predictable reminder only; raw observation kept separate from interpretation

course_objective: Reorient fully and carry one state into action
source_locator: QCTP training loop EXIT -> RECORD -> ADAPT
source_operation: Restore ordinary body, room, time, and task orientation before ending
source_faithful_baseline: Feel feet, chair, hands, natural breath, room, and time of day; open eyes; identify one quality to carry into the next action
qctp_enhancement: Return begins with a full minute remaining; support bed shifts toward neutral alertness; completion and state credit remain separate

source_operation: Record starting versus ending state, attention capture, appreciation shift, narrow/broad contrast, startle, breath comfort, and one integration action
qctp_enhancement: Local transcription; immutable raw entry; source segment tags; bounded adaptation only
